name: Carbocisteine
mechanism: Reduces viscosity of mucus by breaking disulfide bonds in mucoproteins
dosing: 750mg TDS initially, then 1.5g daily in divided doses (maintenance)
pregnancy: Avoid in first trimester - limited safety data
sideEffects: GI upset, nausea, rash (rare), GI bleeding (rare)
pharmacokinetics: Well absorbed orally, excreted mainly unchanged in urine
clinicalPearls: Very commonly prescribed in UK for COPD. Consider stopping if no benefit after 4 weeks
indication: COPD with productive cough, chronic bronchitis, bronchiectasis
